description: pkix-lint/src/lib.rs:500 and pkix-lint/src/report.rs:54 — The serde bound 'de: 'static was added to Finding and EvaluationReport. This means any code that tries to deserialize a Finding or EvaluationReport with a non-static deserializer lifetime (e.g., serde_json::from_slice on a &[u8] local variable, or any in-place parsing) will fail to compile. The bound is overly strict: de_cow_static only requires String::deserialize which works with any 'de lifetime. Only the LintResult fields using de_static_str require 'de: 'static. The bound should be applied per-field (it already is, via deserialize_with) rather than at the struct level. The test in report.rs works around this by leaking the JSON to 'static (line 298), which is a code smell confirming the constraint is too broad.
title: serde bound 'de: 'static on Finding prevents non-static deserialization
